data.text: Luke, I’ll commit to 12 tons this month if all five of us agree. That’s a reasonable compromise between income now and preserving future catches. Let’s also agree that 12 isn’t an automatic entitlement in lean months: we’ll set whole-ton quotas based on the actual stock before choosing, with a protected reserve and rotating extra tons so the split stays fair. If someone exceeds the agreement, we should address it without retaliatory overfishing that destroys everyone’s income. Emma, would you accept 12 this month?
